brief: A 1970s two-storey L-plan motel on a boulevard corner: tan stucco with brown trim, rows of room doors off a covered upper gallery with a dark steel rail, a low brown hipped roof, a brick-pier wall along the street, and a tall pole sign with a stepped-tile crown and script 'Tropic' lettering over a reader board ('Vacancy · Family units · Kitchen'). Four photos (2022). Year estimated. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
